simple.meaning: מִתְקָה (Mithqâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “Mithkah , a place in the Desert.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מִתְקָה (H4989) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 33:28, with occurrences in Numbers.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִתְקָה (H4989) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִתְקָה (H4989) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מִתְקָה (Mithqâh) / H4989 is traced through Numbers 33:28, Numbers 33:29 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
